sonnet.q1: They don't differ. Both get a 401 login page with "Invalid email or password". For an unknown email the server still does a bcrypt compare against a dummy hash and records the failure, so timing and lockout behave the same.
sonnet.q2: The email will already have a lock row, since the fifth failure sets locked_until to now + 15 min. The attempt gets 429 Too many attempts. The password is not checked and the attempt is not recorded, so it can't extend the lock.
sonnet.q3: The old session row is deleted from the sessions table. A new session ID is generated and inserted, and the browser gets Set-Cookie sid with the new ID.
sonnet.q4: The cookie holds only the session ID, with no user data. Page scripts can't read it because it is HttpOnly. It is also Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=43200 (12 h).
sonnet.q5: At 12 hours after login (created_at). Activity keeps resetting the 30-minute idle clock, but the 12 h limit is absolute. The cookie's Max-Age is also 12 h.
sonnet.q6: It deletes the session row if one exists. It responds 302 to /login and clears the sid cookie (Max-Age=0). (If storage fails, it returns 503 and doesn't serve the page.)
sonnet.q7: The server deletes the session row by sid, and this is a no-op if the row is already gone. It then responds 302 to /login and clears sid (Max-Age=0). If storage fails, it returns 503 and leaves the cookie in place.
sonnet.q8: Session state is in the sessions table in the shared Postgres database, not in process memory. Either instance reads the row by the sid from the cookie.
sonnet.q9: Failures are kept in the login_failures table, one row per failed attempt with email and failed_at. The server counts that email's rows whose failed_at is within the 10 minutes ending now (sliding window). Old rows simply stop counting, and the cleanup job deletes them.
sonnet.q10: It compares now with last_seen_at (at most 30 min) and with created_at (at most 12 h). When the session is valid it sets last_seen_at = now, which restarts the idle clock.
sonnet.q11: A 503 error page with no Set-Cookie. The user stays logged out.
sonnet.q12: The hourly cleanup job, which can run on any instance. It deletes session rows idle over 30 min or older than 12 h. Expired sessions are also deleted when found on a request.
